headline: Waist-high short-period S junk — grab the log early or wait it out.
today: Marginal angle and 4-5s period means it's mushy and gutless, but there's enough push for a longboard session. Dawn and morning have the cleanest cross texture before the SSW cross-on fills in through the afternoon, so go early around the mid-morning low. Log or a big groveler, don't expect much shape.

daysToWatch.note: Basically a repeat of today — same size, morning cross window before onshore builds by evening. Get it before noon.
Swell drops under 2ft and onshore takes over. Flat, junky stretch begins through midweek.
Longer-period SE finally shows on a good angle, but it's tiny at under a foot and buried under 20mph wind. Watch it, don't count on it.
